Trigger Condition: Cold load on Chromium / Edge browser
Production Manifestation: Console warning: 'A preload for .../index-DFJN9XAf.css is found, but is not used because the request credentials mode does not match...'
Root Cause: Early Hints header in _headers omitted 'crossorigin' attribute while Vite HTML included 'crossorigin' on <link rel=stylesheet>
Remediation Applied: Updated writeEarlyHints in scripts/generate-pages.js to include crossorigin on stylesheet preload hints

Trigger Condition: Page title line configured with tone: accent and effect: words or typewriter
Production Manifestation: Title text renders completely invisible on mobile Safari (WebKit) and Chrome (Blink) during and after animation (0 visible pixels)
Root Cause: Parent .hero-title-effect with background-clip: text and color: transparent does not clip nested inline-block words with 3D transforms
Remediation Applied: causing children to inherit transparent color without background clipping
column8: Added CSS inheritance rules in src/styles/hero-title-effects.css for words and characters under bg-clip-text

Trigger Condition: User scrolls into deferred sections during transient mobile network disconnection or high packet drop
Production Manifestation: Application throws unhandled chunk load error; entire page unmounts and crashes into RouteErrorBoundary full-page reload view, destroying the active Hero and scroll state
Root Cause: DeferredSection lacked an ErrorBoundary. Chunk rejection bubbled through React tree to route root
Remediation Applied: Implemented SectionErrorBoundary in src/app/components/SectionErrorBoundary.tsx, wrapping Suspense in Home.tsx and ServiceLandingPage.tsx with automatic retry on online event
